label: TP
reason: User input from getQueryString flows directly into doSomething and is assigned to variable bar without any sanitization or encoding. The decoded parameter is returned via response.getWriter().print(bar), which is an XSS sink where attacker-supplied script tags can be executed.

evidence.note: User input extracted from query string and passed through decode without validation before being used in doSomething
Variable bar containing user input is printed directly to response stream without escaping
